name: Treasure Seekers 2: The Enchanted Canvases
storyline: Help Nelly find and save her brother from a mysterious Romanian castle! Dive into the castles magical pictures and discover the secrets of the Philosophers Stone. Use your Hidden Object skills in Treasure Seekers: The Enchanted Canvases to break the spells on the castle and track down Tom. Find the wicked person responsible for imprisoning him and take home the ancient and priceless treasure!
